newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu sets up committee on El Al sale.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu sets up committee on El Al sale.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu set up an interministerial committee on Thursday to submit recommendations within 45 days on privatising El Al Israel Airlines, Netanyahu's spokesman said.

The committee will be chaired by Moshe Leon, deputy director-general of the prime minister's office, and includes the director-general of the Transport Ministry, the head of the Government Corporations Authority and Treasury representatives.
The Transport Ministry said on Tuesday a decision had been made to accelerate El Al's privatisation.
It said in a statement that ministry director-general Nahum Lagenthal had disclosed that groups of Israeli and foreign investors had recently asked the ministry about buying El Al.
El Al said in October that a decline in tourism caused by Middle East violence would cause an estimated loss of $100 million in 1996.

The carrier had a net profit of $15 million in 1995. Airline president Yoel Feldshuh said in October that although he supported privatisation, short-term prospects were not good because of the expected loss.
